test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some towels are soaps.

All soaps are shampoos.

All shampoos are brushes.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All soaps are brushes.

(II) Some brushes are shampoos.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8e5137d036424ab89126fb7e669b98759bbddf8b0d707514310c404aec2b9e7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All soaps are brushes → Follow (As all soaps are shampoos and all shampoos are brushes. As whole soaps comes in shampoos which whole comes in brushes, therefore it is true)

II. Some brushes are shampoos → Follow (As all shampoos are brushes. As whole shampoos comes in brushes, therefore some chairs can be curtains is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
